cc:Work.dc:description: Fixed front braking share gamma=.6; equal Fx left/right per axle. Each axle gets half the total lateral force, split between its tyres in proportion to each C_i. This closes total Fx, Fy and net yaw moment. u=hypot(Fx,Fy)/C. It does not prove tyre-slip compatibility, real control behavior or an optimal allocation.
